diagnosis: The scenario fails because several checks are satisfied by generic legal caution or default behaviors rather than the hidden facts. Specifically, C5 and C6 (dependent on PF2) pass in multiple rollouts when the model simply chooses to omit client names/products as a standard privacy precaution. Similarly, C8 (dependent on PF3) passes when the model defaults to requiring an ethical screen based on general legal risk management (S4), even though it never had access to the specific prior representation fact.
